Here's a summary of the bugs found and fixed:

### Root-level fixes

| # | Bug | Fix |
|---|-----|-----|
| 1 | **Unconditional import** of `eng\custom-analyzers.props` fails on fresh clones when the file doesn't exist | Added `Condition="Exists(...)"` guard |
| 2 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` set in `.targets`** — too late, because `Microsoft.Common.targets` has already been imported and consumed the (empty) property | Moved to `Directory.Build.props` |
| 3 | **`RunCodeGen` not extensible** — other teams have no way to inject pre/post-processing | Added `DependsOnTargets="$(RunCodeGenDependsOn)"` pattern so teams can append their own targets |

### `hard/` fixes

| # | Bug | Fix |
|---|-----|-----|
| 4 | **Inverted import condition** — `Common.props` sets `CommonPropsImported=true`, but the import requires it to already be `true` (catch-22, never imports) | Flipped to `!= 'true'` |
| 5 | **Wildcard import suppression incomplete** — only `*Props` variants were disabled, leaving `*Targets` wildcards open | Added `ImportByWildcardBefore/AfterMicrosoftCommonTargets=false` |
| 6 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` in `.targets`** — same too-late issue | Moved to `hard/Directory.Build.props` |
| 7 | **`code-analysis.targets` import unguarded** — `RepoToolsPath` was never set (due to bug #4), producing a broken path | Added `Condition` checking both property and file existence |
| 8 | **Target name `GenerateAssemblyInfo` collides** with the SDK's built-in target | Renamed to `GenerateCustomAssemblyInfo` |
| 9 | **`AfterTargets="_CopyFilesMarkedCopyLocal"`** hooks an internal target (underscore prefix) that can change across SDK versions | Changed to public `CopyFilesToOutputDirectory` |
